list_card_items: 1. Pick 15 dishes the family asks for
2. FAVOURITE: speak each recipe as a voice note; ChatGPT or Gemini (free) turns it into a neat page with quantities
4. List it on Topmate (INR) or Gumroad (pays in dollars), fee as each site's pricing page states at render
header.money_rules: docs/MONEY.md in full: ₹199 labelled EXAMPLE PRICE on screen, no sales numbers under Prashant's name, catch said out loud, Results vary. in caption
header.named_viewer: homemakers at home (kicker on the line-0 card: FOR HOMEMAKERS)
notes: Fees are not spoken. The step-4 card shows each fee only as copied from the Topmate and Gumroad pricing pages at render. If a fee can't be confirmed there, the card says 'fee: see pricing page'.
Before render, confirm Topmate and Gumroad are listed in docs/MONEY.md or in this week's research. If either is missing, drop it from the card and the voice line.
Confirm the PRODUCT keyword has its Weekend Digital Product tool on the tools page (housekeeping step 4).
Spoken length is about 96 words, roughly 28 to 29 s at speed 1.05. That fits the 20 to 30 s window but runs over the 60 to 80 word guide. To trim, cut 'pick' from line 2 or 'whole' from line 8.
